data.name: History_Subtitle
data.value: Clips from this PC and paired devices · cleanup affects this device only

data.name: History_Empty_Unpaired_Body
data.value: Not paired with a phone yet. The pairing entrance is in the network segment of the Conduit page.

data.name: History_Empty_Paired_Body
data.value: Copy text on either device — it appears here and flows to the other side.

data.name: History_Empty_Filtered
data.value: No entries of this type · try another filter

data.name: Conduit_Subtitle
data.value: Content flows left to right through four segments · reading order is troubleshooting order

data.name: Conduit_Capture_Detail
data.value: Private mode and blocked processes stop content at this segment.

data.name: Conduit_Service_DetailPrefix
data.value: Events land in the store before the outbox ·

data.name: Conduit_Peer_AutoApplyOn
data.value: Remote text is written to this PC’s clipboard automatically.

data.name: Conduit_Peer_AutoApplyOff
data.value: Auto-apply is off: remote content stays in history only and needs manual copying.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_Desc
data.value: The highest-quality rung of the Android background-read ladder: the PC uses adb to help a paired phone start its built-in privileged host, after which the phone's background copies upload instantly. Every step needs your explicit consent — never silent.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_ConsentBody
data.value: Once allowed, this PC will call adb (the Android Debug Bridge) to send the phone one start command. adb runs only on your click each time — never resident, never silent. The first time you must also enable USB debugging on the phone and accept its adb authorization prompt by hand — Android does not allow automating that step.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_ManualNote
data.value: First connection: on the phone, enable Developer options → USB debugging (or wireless debugging), then tap Allow in the "Allow USB debugging" prompt. This step can only be done by hand on the phone.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_TapDetect
data.value: Tap "Detect phone" to see the current state.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_AdbMissing
data.value: adb was not found. Install the Android platform-tools, or drop a platform-tools folder next to this app.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_NoDevice
data.value: No phone detected. Connect it by cable with USB debugging on, or set up wireless debugging.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_Unauthorized
data.value: Phone connected but debugging is not authorized yet. Tap "Allow USB debugging" on the phone.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_Offline
data.value: Phone attached but reported offline. Reconnect it and try again.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_RunningFormat
data.value: {0}: the privileged read channel is running.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_StoppedFormat
data.value: {0} is ready; the privileged channel is not running. Tap "Start privileged read" to open it.

data.name: Conduit_Privileged_StartOk
data.value: Start command sent. On the phone's conduit page, tap "Re-probe" to confirm privileged read is ready.

data.name: Conduit_Bluetooth_Desc
data.value: Off by default. When the LAN is blocked by a VPN or firewall, a phone already Bluetooth-paired in system settings keeps syncing text (no images, slower).

data.name: Conduit_ExtraBind_Desc
data.value: For virtual-adapter addresses such as Tailscale / WireGuard. No public relay is provided.

data.name: Conduit_Fingerprint_Desc
data.value: When pairing, compare it group by group with the fingerprint shown on the phone. A fingerprint change makes every paired device ask to re-confirm.

data.name: Conduit_Fingerprint_Unavailable
data.value: The peer service is not running; no fingerprint to show this session.

data.name: Device_RevokeNote
data.value: Revoking disconnects the device immediately and voids its pairing key; content it already received is never deleted remotely. Pairing again after revocation counts as a new device. When the same phone re-pairs under a new identity, the old record is revoked automatically and its outbox cleared.

data.name: Stale_BannerBacklogFormat
data.value: Devices that look like stale leftovers: {0}; pending items inflating the outbox count: {1}. Cleanup revokes them and clears their outboxes.

data.name: Stale_BannerFormat
data.value: Devices that look like stale leftovers: {0}. Cleanup revokes them; content they already received is unaffected.

data.name: Prefs_Subtitle
data.value: Changes apply immediately · clipboard content never appears in logs

data.name: Prefs_FontScale_Desc
data.value: Scales only clip content text (history previews, detail body, tray flyout); group headers, badges, and buttons are unchanged.

data.name: Prefs_PreviewLines_Desc
data.value: Maximum body lines shown per entry in the history list; overflow is truncated with an ellipsis — open details for the full content.

data.name: Prefs_Theme_Desc
data.value: The window’s day/night palette; the tray icon lives in the taskbar and always follows the taskbar’s shade.

data.name: Prefs_Language_Desc
data.value: The UI language — follow the system or set one manually; each language always shows its own native name.

data.name: Prefs_Language_RestartNote
data.value: Takes effect after restarting the app.

data.name: Prefs_Capture_Pause_Desc
data.value: While paused, this PC stops recording new content; existing history is kept.

data.name: Prefs_Capture_Private_Desc
data.value: While on, capture and sync stop entirely, leaving no trace.

data.name: Prefs_Capture_Blocked_Desc
data.value: Copies from these processes never enter history or sync. Separate with commas or line breaks.

data.name: Prefs_Sync_AutoApply_Desc
data.value: Text from the phone is written to this PC’s clipboard automatically. When off it stays in history only and needs manual copying.

data.name: Prefs_Sync_ImageSync_Desc
data.value: Off by default. PNG/JPEG only; raw bytes may carry EXIF and other metadata, and both ends need a v2 session.

data.name: Prefs_Sync_AutoApplyImages_Desc
data.value: Images from the phone are written to this PC’s clipboard automatically. When off they stay in history only and need manual copying.

data.name: Prefs_Moved_Title
data.value: Bluetooth fallback · extra listen addresses · certificate fingerprint

data.name: Prefs_Moved_Desc
data.value: Moved to Conduit · network segment — they decide whether content can reach the peer, so they live with pairing and device management.

data.name: Prefs_Retention_Days_Desc
data.value: Entries past the deadline are removed automatically. Cleanup happens on this PC only and never deletes what the peer already received.

data.name: Prefs_Retention_Entries_Desc
data.value: When over the cap, the oldest entries are removed first (100–2000, steps of 100). Cleanup happens on this PC only.

data.name: Prefs_Startup_Launch_Title
data.value: Launch at startup · silently to tray

data.name: Prefs_Startup_Launch_Desc
data.value: Starts automatically at Windows sign-in and lands straight in the tray without opening the main window. Writes only the current user’s startup entry; no administrator rights needed.

data.name: Prefs_Startup_Hotkey_Desc
data.value: Press the combination in any app to summon the tray flyout. Click the box, then press the combination you want (must include Ctrl, Alt, or Win); press Backspace to clear. Off by default.

data.name: Prefs_Data_Export_Desc
data.value: Writes the whole history (including deletion markers) as a JSON Lines backup file; no keys, certificates, or pairing data. The export is plaintext — keep it safe.

data.name: Prefs_Data_Import_Desc
data.value: Merges history from a backup file: idempotent on “source device + sequence”, so re-importing never duplicates entries or overrides local deletions. Validation failures change nothing.

data.name: Prefs_Data_Clear_Desc
data.value: Deletes all entries on this PC (including images) in one step; takes two confirmations and cannot be undone. Clearing happens on this PC only and never deletes what the peer already received — consider exporting first.

data.name: Flyout_Empty
data.value: No clips yet · try copying some text

data.name: Tray_Tooltip_Private
data.value: ClipSync · private mode, leaves no trace

data.name: Tray_OversizeNotice
data.value: The text just copied exceeds 1 MiB; it stays on this PC’s clipboard only and is not synced (not truncated).

data.name: Tray_AuthThrottleFormat
data.value: Repeated authentication failures from “{0}”; the device is temporarily throttled.

data.name: Capture_OversizeNotice
data.value: The text just copied exceeds 1 MiB: it stays on the system clipboard, untruncated, but is not recorded in history or synced.

data.name: Sync_StartFailed
data.value: The peer service failed to start; sync is off for this session.

data.name: Sync_ConnectedFormat
data.value: LAN listening on port {0} · devices connected: {1}, content flows in real time.

data.name: Sync_WaitingFormat
data.value: LAN listening on port {0} · waiting for paired devices; events land in the store before the outbox, so nothing is lost offline.

data.name: Bt_Armed
data.value: Bluetooth fallback standing by · the phone switches to Bluetooth automatically when the LAN is unreachable

data.name: Bt_AdapterUnavailable
data.value: Bluetooth adapter unavailable or turned off

data.name: Transfer_ClearedFormat

data.name: Transfer_ClearConfirmBody
data.value:
Clear all history?
This deletes every entry on this PC (including images) in one step. Clearing happens on this PC only and never deletes what the peer already received. Consider “Export history” first.

data.name: Transfer_ClearConfirmAgain
data.value: Confirm once more: clearing cannot be undone. Clear all history?

data.name: Transfer_ExportWriteFailed

data.name: Transfer_ImportReadFailed
data.value: Import failed: could not read the chosen file.

data.name: Transfer_Error_BadHeader

data.name: Transfer_Error_UnsupportedVersion
data.value: the file version is newer than this app supports

data.name: Transfer_Error_HashMismatch

data.name: Transfer_Error_CountMismatch
data.value: the file is incomplete (count does not match the header)

data.name: Transfer_Error_ContentTooLarge
data.value: the file contains an entry over the size caps (text 1 MiB / images 16 MiB)

data.name: Hotkey_Applied
data.value: Active · press it in any app to summon the flyout

data.name: Hotkey_Conflict
data.value: That combination is taken by another program; try a different one

data.name: Attention_PeerDown
data.value: Sync not running this session (endpoint failed to start)

data.name: Attention_NoDevice
data.value: Pair a device to start syncing

data.name: Pairing_PeerDownBody
data.value: The peer service is not running; pairing is unavailable this session.

data.name: Pairing_ScanInstruction
data.value: Scan this code with ClipSync on your phone. The QR code carries this PC’s address, certificate fingerprint, and a one-time token — never the pairing key.

data.name: Pairing_NoLanAddress
data.value: No LAN address detected. Put this PC and the phone on the same network (or add a Tailscale address in Preferences), then reopen this window.

data.name: Pairing_VerifyHeading
data.value: Verify on the phone before approving

data.name: Approval_Body
data.value: A device used this PC’s QR code to request pairing. Approve only if the name below matches the phone in your hand.

data.name: Approval_RepairWarning
data.value: This device was paired before. Approving replaces its existing pairing key, and the old install stops working immediately.

data.name: Approval_SupersedeNotice
data.value: A device with the same name is already listed. Approving revokes the old record automatically and clears its outbox (treated as the same phone re-pairing).

data.name: Diag_Heading
data.value: Local diagnostics · status codes and times only, never clipboard content
